specs.title: unauthorised: /admin without a session redirects to the login page
incorrect password shows an error and stays on the login page
empty fields are rejected client-side with a clear message
forgot password: asks for an email first, then confirms the reset request was sent
a valid user that is NOT an admin is refused and signed out (participants never get admin rights)
correct password opens the dashboard; session persists across refresh; logout ends it
expired session: reload sends the admin back to login; in-page actions show a session-expired message
admin-only data is not reachable with a forged or missing token
1. admin creates the game: 3 topics => 21-question minimum, pools generated, game created in the database
2. participants: add, duplicate/invalid rejected, unique links, Copy Invite Link and WhatsApp work
3. Participants edit / regenerate (old link revoked) / remove are safe
4. admin starts the game (confirmed in the database); invalid invitation tokens are rejected
5. four players join from four separate browser sessions
6. challenges: A->C Movies, B->C Cricket, D->C AI, C->A Movies (each with exactly 7 ordered questions)
7. Amal receives THREE independent challenges (3 links); the others see one
8. Amal answers the 3 challenges: 7 correct, 7 wrong (with a mid-quiz refresh), 5 correct; Arun answers 3 of 7
9. admin monitoring reflects all of it live (no manual refresh) with separate progress per challenge
10. correct answers never reached any player browser before completion
11. live leaderboard (public page, anonymous browser) counts finished challenges only
12. admin completes the game (confirmation, real DB change); answers are revealed and scores finalised
13. participants see revealed results: scores out of 70, correct answers, final leaderboard with ties
14. admin leaderboard tab: ranking, refresh, CSV export
15. a completed game accepts no new answers or challenges (server-side), even via direct API calls
1. regression: switching games loads THAT game (roster, links, pools) - never the previous game
2. create-game validation in the UI: duplicate open name, invalid min/max, disabled topics not offered
2b. Edit Game modal + Games-tab Refresh: validation, save, and the change is real
3. start -> pause -> resume from the UI; players see the pause live and cannot answer meanwhile
4. cancel: confirmation, CANCELLED status, old links show cancelled, records preserved, no restart
5. delete: in-progress games are locked; confirmation names the game and impact; other games untouched; old links die
6. retention cleanup removes ONLY old completed/cancelled games; active/paused/registration are never touched
7. topics: add, duplicate refused, edit, disable/enable, safe delete, search & filter, usage counts
8. game rules: edit & save per game, locked after start, defaults apply to NEW games only
9. maximum participants enforced in the UI; two admin tabs: stale tab gets a clear server error, not silent success
10. network interruption: admin and participant get clear errors and recover when back online
11. AI unavailable + custom topic with no questions: game is created but cannot start; message names the topic
12. overview statistics come from real records and match the database
13. overview buttons: Test Connection, Live Monitor, View all & manage, Select & view
14. two players pick the SAME friend: the 2nd sees the used topic disabled up-front and can still send a different topic
1. public key cannot read any sensitive table (participants, assignments, questions, answers, scores, secrets, events, settings)
2. games.settings (publicly readable) holds no question pool / correct answers; no hashes or tokens are public
3. the exploit chain is closed: reading tables to obtain a "token hash" then using it as a credential
4. every admin RPC rejects the public key and a signed-in NON-admin user
5. participant data is isolated: a player only ever receives their own challenge links
6. invalid / malformed / hostile tokens and ids are rejected cleanly (no 500s)
7. forged client scores are impossible: no write path exists for answers/scores from the browser
8. AI endpoint source: admin-only, no wildcard CORS, key never in a URL (static check of the deployed handler)
9. no service-role / secret keys in the shipped bundle or in VITE_ variables
